note: Written before the S1 harness ran. Expected status is PASS for every assigned scenario; any observed FAIL or NOT RUN is a provisional agent result and requires parent review.

S1-01.title: ESM entry import
S1-01.expected: Import from the installed tarball succeeds; documented named exports and eight sheet-ordered styles exist; no network attempt, no global mutation, and no package-tree mutation during import.

S1-02.title: All eight renderers direct render
S1-02.expected: Each of the eight direct renderers returns non-empty well-formed SVG for seeds alice, bob, 用户 and empty at explicit px; root svg namespace, width/height and viewBox are present; non-letter extra name arguments are ignored.

S1-03.title: Default option equivalence
S1-03.expected: ditherFace(seed), ditherFace(seed, {}), explicit pixel-sprite/80 options and pixelSprite(seed, 80) are byte-identical; every direct renderer rejects a missing px.

S1-04.title: Invalid options
S1-04.expected: Invalid seed/name/px/style/options types, null, arrays, NaN, Infinity, zero and negative px throw; unknown extra keys are ignored; positive finite fractions, tiny and large px are accepted with no undocumented cap and do not change viewBox/design.

S1-05.title: Unicode and normalization
S1-05.expected: Empty, whitespace, emoji, combining, CJK, RTL, punctuation, control and 10k-character seeds render deterministically without crash/hang, remain well-formed and safe; name NFD normalization is covered by S1-06 as documented.

S1-06.title: Initials extraction
S1-06.expected: All three letter styles use the documented initial (NFD accent strip, first ASCII letter/digit uppercased, ? fallback), omitted name defaults to seed, empty name falls back to ?, and a differing name changes only the glyph while seeded background/color/clip output is unchanged.

S1-07.title: Strict TypeScript declarations
S1-07.expected: Strict NodeNext consumer compiles with tsc 7.0.2; invalid StyleSlug, options and seed fixtures fail with TypeScript errors; readonly registry mutation fails; the tarball contains and points to dist/index.d.ts.

S1-08.title: SVG validity and safe markup
S1-08.expected: Every generated SVG parses as XML with the SVG namespace, dimensions and viewBox; no script, on* handler, foreignObject, executable or external reference is present. Negative controls prove the checker rejects malformed XML, script, event handlers, foreignObject, external/data references and doctype/entity payloads.
